title: Packers DC Jonathan Gannon: It's not what scheme you play, it's how you play

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Packers DC Jonathan Gannon: It's not what scheme you play, it's how you play
sources.description: Packers defensive coordinator Jonathan Gannon has been running defenses in the NFL for a while, but anyone expecting the approach in Green Bay to look like the ones he employed in Arizona and Philadelphia is going to be disappointed.
